title.en: Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2014

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2014 and shall come into operation on 1st April 2014.
